name: Rock Gnome Upbringing

benefits.description: Gain proficiency in the native Tinkering Competency, associated with Tinker's Tools. The association does not automatically grant equipment ownership or a separate equipment qualification.
Double Proficiency Bonus on qualifying Intelligence (History) checks involving magical, alchemical or technological objects.
May make appropriate clockwork devices using the Tinkering Competency, proper tools, materials and time.
Learn a technique combining Tinkering Competency and Prestidigitation. Does not automatically grant Mending.

reviewNotes: Spellcasting ability for Upbringing-granted Prestidigitation remains unresolved.
